3259-8201--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-8201--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

3899-7096--5.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
3899-7096--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1308-2583-4636.description:

When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

624-670-1619-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1263-2292-4871-6887.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1682-2079-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-2079-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-4766-6990.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Michelangelo.
When Michelangelo dies, it and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Michelangelo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Michelangelo from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3470-5478-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3470-5478-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters untapped due to Spelunking.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3713-4499-6252.description:
Activate Boommobile's crew ability by tapping Steelfin Whale, causing Boommobile to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Boommobile.
When Boommobile enters the battlefield, it and Steelfin Whale trigger.
Resolve the Steelfin Whale trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boommobile trigger, adding four mana of any color that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat

3525-5268-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

3525-3755-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

2178-3817-5147-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-5147-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2511-5276-5332-6524.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

647-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
647-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-5733-6122.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1309-5733-6122.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Salvager of Secrets by paying its mana cost.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Salvager of Secrets from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

413-1365-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-1365-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
When Arsenal Thresher enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

7-2908-3682-5542.description:

Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

301-5256-5643.notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-5256-5643.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Putrid Goblin's power.
Repeat.

A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
877-4050-4254-4484.description:

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1046-1479-3678.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
1046-1479-3678.description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

224-751-3052.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
224-751-3052.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Karametra triggers, causing you to search your library for a Forest or Plains and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Forest or Plains enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3598-3750-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Rapacious One.
3598-3750-4050.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Rapacious One.
Rapacious One triggers, creating five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing the five Eldrazi Spawn, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2034-3026-4302-4802.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Angel, adding {C}{C}.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters and becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Bishop of Wings triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

228-2457-4277.description:
Activate Ant Queen creating a 1/1 token.
Equip Skullclamp to the token.
The token dies drawing you 2 cards.
Exile both cards from your hand to gain {2}{G}{G}.
